title: Graduate Management Consultant - Summer 2027
description:
Rystad Energy’s graduate consultants work on research and advisory projects for energy companies, investors and governments. You will start with a structured training programme and then join client projects from day one, building models and writing up insights.

What you'll do

  • Analyse supply, demand and cost data across oil, gas and renewables
  • Build Excel models and turn the results into clear client presentations
  • Work with experienced consultants on proposals and project delivery

What we're looking for

  • A recent or upcoming degree in engineering, economics, finance or a similar field

  • Strong numerical skills and attention to detail

  • Interest in the energy transition and the businesses behind it
